evidence.excerpt: oads in New England remain limited in number and scale – Recent data collected from Transmission Owners (TOs) suggest there are a couple hundred MW of large loads in the formal study phase – To date, New England has not witnessed the scale of data center proposals seen in other regions of the country • The ISO has developed a quarterly survey that is issued to TOs to collect information on prospective large loads – Survey responses will help the ISO to proactively characterize and incorporate large loads into the long-term load forecast – Needed data sources and information are still being collected and researched • ISO staff have been actively participating in internal discussions, dialog with other ISOs, and industry task forces/working groups to support ongoing data and knowledge acquisition 3 ISO-NE PUBLIC FORECAST METHODOLOGY 4 ISO-NE PUBLIC Large Load

limitations: Google의 검토·매입 관심 단계입니다. OG&E 계약 대상 Stillwater·Muskogee 세 곳과 다른 부지이며 공급사를 지역만으로 추정하지 않습니다.

entities.name: Meta Stanton Springs data center
limitations: 운영 건물과 장기 확장계획이 함께 있을 수 있습니다. 기존 캠퍼스를 신규 미통전 접속신청으로 합산하지 않습니다.
Georgia Power 익명 행과 고객명·MW만으로 중복 연결하지 않습니다.

entities.name: Project Aether / Alpha–Clarksville phased data center
entities.utility: Clarksville Connected Utilities / Southwestern Power Administration
limitations: 상세 연구가 명시한 단일 단계별 데이터센터 개발입니다. 816MW는 연구 시나리오이며 계약 접속신청 MW로 확정하지 않습니다.
보고서 완료·NTC는 고객 공사·통전 완료를 뜻하지 않습니다.

entities.name: Sofidel — Rocky Point load addition
